prompt.content: Who was the host of Swami Vivekananda for most of the period during his visit to the West in 1900?

output:
The host of Swami Vivekananda during most of his visit to the West in 1900 was **J.
J.J. Mahadevan**. He was the President of the Ramakrishna Mission and the main organizer of Vivekananda's first Western tour.
